Stops timing the part of the program that [ProfileSectionStart](ProfileSectionStart) started under this key, and adds its time to the key for the current frame. Ending a key that was not started does nothing. Without `--profile` (or `-d`) this command does nothing.

```blitzbasic
ProfileSectionStart "load"
; ...
ProfileSectionEnd "load"
```
@param key  The name of the part, the same as for ProfileSectionStart.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
